messages:
sam: Hi all 0% newbie question for Germany onboarding: when does statutory health insurance (GKV) coverage begin? my start date was 2/10 and the portal says 'pending' for health enrollment. also wondering about social security number (Sozialversicherungsnummer) registration timeline and whether relocation reimbursement is in the same pay run as first salary.

dana-peopleops: welcome, sam! :wave: quick answers: GKV enrollment typically becomes active on your official start date if you provided your previous insurance info. if you switched from private to statutory, it can take 2	6 weeks to propagate. for new hires without prior German coverage, the EOR requests assignment of the SV number and it can take ~3 weeks.

sam: thanks. i filled the "health info" form and uploaded my docs but got an upload error: 422 - "invalid_mime_type". tried pdf and png. anyone seen this?

peopleops-bot: Automated check: Uploaded file rejected - invalid_mime_type. Accepted types: application/pdf, image/png, image/jpeg. Max size 8MB. If you continue to see errors, please try a different browser or attach here (we can intake securely).

carla-payroll: hey sam  re: reimbursement  relocation reimbursements are processed as a separate reimbursement batch, not combined with the regular salary by default. expect reimbursement on the next reimbursement cycle after approval (usually within 2 payroll cycles). If you selected "gross-up" for tax handling, let us know so payroll can apply the correct withholding.

sam: ah ok, so salary and reimbursement separate. good to know. re: PTO: i'm starting mid-month on a part-time schedule (0.6 FTE) - how is holiday accrual prorated for Germany?

dana-peopleops: prorate depends on your contract. standard is accrual by month pro rata based on FTE. example: 30 days annual on 1.0 FTE -> at 0.6 FTE you'd get 18 days/year, then prorated by join month. If you need exact day math, share your contract start and we'll run numbers.

sam: perfect. i'll DM the start details if that's easier. also, i can re-upload the health docs here if you want to intake them manually (system keeps rejecting).

dana-peopleops: yes please attach here and we'll move to secure intake. include: passport, Anmeldung (if you have it), previous insurer confirmation (if applicable). we'll mark as expedited given the SV number request.

carla-payroll: one more note: tax class (Steuerklasse) defaults based on the info employee provided. if your tax withholding looks off on your payslip, ping payroll within 5 days of the payslip date so we can correct the next cycle.

sam: thanks everyone. attaching files now. appreciate the quick help! :raised_hands:

peopleops-bot: Dana assigned: "Manual intake - Germany health docs".

dana-peopleops: got them, starting manual intake. we'll confirm once SV number is requested and when reimbursement is scheduled. welcome aboard again! :tada:
